services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: From first campfires to big challenges, our summer camps give Scouts experiences they can’t get at home-and memories that last a lifetime. With age-appropriate program areas, outdoor activities, and a full day-camp experience, campers enjoy all the fun of summer camp-without traveling far from home. An overnight summer camp for Cub Scouts entering 1st-5th grade, offering outdoor adventures, hands-on activities, and a supportive environment that builds confidence, skills, and lifelong friends. blurb: A Timeless Journey:90 Years of Adventure For 90 years, Camp Carpenter has shaped generations of Scouts through outdoor adventure, lasting friendships, and timeless Scouting traditions. Join us as we celebrate the legacy and the future of a camp unlike any other.
